title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 2. Urban planning and policy making, including master plans for participating towns strengthened. Indicator: At least 8 km of heating pipeline supplied, installed, and operational Achievement: 17.02 Progress/Status: Target surpassed by 2015 with 8.95 km installed under the G0204 project, 2.97 km under L3388 project, and 5.1 km under the L3713 project. Data Source: Urban service company records Project management reports provided to ADB Site inspections and government records ADB project monitoring reports and PCR

Output: 3. Cross-border cooperation established Indicator: 3 heat distribution centers installed and operational Achievement: 1 Progress/Status: Target achieved by 2023 with 3 heat distribution centers installed by 2015 under the G0204 project and surpassed by 1 additional heat distribution center installed under the L3388 project by December 2019 and one under the L3713 project by October 2021 Data Source: Urban service company records Project management reports provided to ADB Site inspections and government records ADB project monitoring reports and PCR

Output: 4. Water source development, transmission, storage and distribution completed Indicator: Two solid waste landfill sites constructed and operational Achievement: 1 Progress/Status: Completed. Two landfill sites were constructed under the provincial government budget in Tsogtsetsii and Sainshand soums. Hence, project constructed one landfill site in Zamyn-Uud, and, at the government request, built a waste compaction transfer station and supplied additional waste segregation bins, containers and machinery. Data Source: Annual National Statistics Office Yearbook, national government, quarterly project progress reports of PMU

Output: 7. Surfaced central roads network constructed Indicator: 12 sets of tractors and trailers for solid-waste collection supplied and operational Achievement: 16 Progress/Status: Completed. Data Source: Annual National Statistics Office Yearbook, national government, quarterly project progress reports of PMU

Output: 8. Improved solid waste collection and disposal enhanced Indicator: Two WWTPs of 800 m3/day constructed and operational. Achievement: 2 Progress/Status: Target achieved by 2016, with WTTPs of 200 m3/day and 600 m3/day constructed under G0204. Data Source: Annual National Statistics Office Yearbook, national government, quarterly project progress reports of PMU

Output: Indicator Indicator: 11 water kiosks constructed and operational in ger areas Achievement: 11 Progress/Status: Target achieved by 2023, with 9 kiosks under G0204, 2 kiosks under L3388. Data Source: Annual National Statistics Office Yearbook, national government, quarterly project progress reports of PMU

Output: Indicator Indicator: 3 water reservoirs constructed Achievement: 2 Progress/Status: Target achieved with 4 constructed under the G0204 project by 2015, 2 constructed by the L3388 project by 2022 and 2 constructed by the L3713 project by 2023. Data Source: Annual National Statistics Office Yearbook, national government, quarterly project progress reports of PMU

Output: Indicator Indicator: About 9 km of concrete access roads constructed Achievement: 6 Progress/Status: Completed. In Khanbogd soum, 5 km road was constructed from the source other than the grant (by Oyu Tolgoi), hence at the local government request the project built only 6 km road in the project towns Data Source: Urban service company records Project management reports provided to ADB Site inspections and government records ADB project monitoring reports and PCR

Output: Indicator Indicator: At least 2 km of storm water drainage line installed and operational Achievement: 1.8 Progress/Status: Completed under G0204. 1.8 km storm drainage was built in accordance with the detailed engineering design. Data Source: Annual National Statistics Office Yearbook, national government, quarterly project progress reports of PMU

Output: Indicator Indicator: At least 30% of participants in consultative workshops are women Achievement: 30 Progress/Status: Achieved. Women participation in the consultation process has been recorded and reported. Data Source: Gender action plan implementation report, PMU

Output: Indicator Indicator: At least 30% of participants in public meetings on project design and construction activities are women Achievement: 30 Progress/Status: Completed under G204. Women participation recorded and reported. Data Source: Gender action plan implementation report, PMU

Output: Indicator Indicator: At least 300 PUSO and local government staff with new knowledge and skills on wastewater operations and management Achievement: 1139 Progress/Status: Target achieved with cumulatively 1,193 people trained under G0204, L3388 and L3713. Data Source: Annual National Statistics Office Yearbook, national government, quarterly project progress reports of PMU

Output: Indicator Indicator: At least 35% of PUSO staff trained on wastewater operations and management are women Achievement: 47.5 Progress/Status: Target achieved with 47.5% of trained people were women. Data Source: Gender action plan implementation report, PMU

Output: Indicator Indicator: At least 38 km of transmission and distribution water main installed Achievement: 67.13 Progress/Status: Target of 38 km by 2015 was surpassed with 39.4 km in 2015 under the G0204 project, 15.66 km under L3388 project, and 12.07 km under the L3713 project.
Data Source: Annual National Statistics Office Yearbook, national government, quarterly project progress reports of PMU

Output: 1. Infrastructure services reforms, including perforamance-based contracts for urban services delivery implemented Indicator: Five sets of sewage vacuum trucks and machinery delivered and operational Achievement: 5 Progress/Status: Target achieved with five sets of vacuum truck and equipment delivered by 2022. Data Source: Annual National Statistics Office Yearbook, national government, quarterly project progress reports of PMU

Output: 9. Stormwater drainage infrastructure constructed and operationalized Indicator: Four WWTPs of 3,000 m3/day constructed and operational by December 2022 and five WWTPs of 3,000 m3/day - by June 2023. Achievement: 1 Progress/Status: Target achieved by 2023 with 9 WWTPs of 3,000 m3/day, one WWTP of 310 m3/day, and one WWTP of 50 m3/day completed and operational. Data Source: Annual National Statistics Office Yearbook, national government, quarterly project progress reports of PMU

Output: Indicator Indicator: Four urban plans prepared and adopted by the participating aimag and soum governments Achievement: 4 Progress/Status: Completed. Urban master plans for four soums have been prepared, approved and handed over to the aimag governments. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports of PMU

Output: 6. District heating infrastructure constructed and operationalized Indicator: At least 30 km of sewers installed and operational. Achievement: 2.93 Progress/Status: Target of 30 km by 2015 was surpassed with 35.9 km in 2015 under the G0204 project, 22.96 km under L3388 project, and 23.51 km under the L3713 project. Data Source: Annual National Statistics Office Yearbook, national government, quarterly project progress reports of PMU

Output: 10. Strategic planning management, and cost recovery for wastewater management strengthened Indicator: 8.4 MW (3*2.8) heating boilers supplied, installed, and operational Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Target achieved by 2015. Data Source: Urban service company records Project management reports provided to ADB Site inspections and government records ADB project monitoring reports and PCR Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Indicator Indicator: Operating management contracts for provision of basic services in place and operational in both project aimags Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Package A4 consultants provided advisory services to local governments in identifying a suitable PPP transaction mode approach for public utility services organization (PUSO). Due to unavailability of funds to finance a service fee, replacement of replace operating management contract approach with a lease contract for the existing PUSOs has been proposed. The lease contract includes setting tariffs that will recover operational and maintenance costs including depreciation, service quality targets and required investment. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports of PMU Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2014 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Indicator Indicator: Zamyn-Uud-Erlian Joint Border Development Commission established with urban development working group Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Completed. Working group is established by the Government. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports of PMU Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y Actual value: Y
Urban governance improved and access to sustainable infrastructure and services expanded in urban places in Southeast Gobi and other aimags.

New water, sewerage, SWM, and heating use in planned (non-ger) areas increased to 95% in four soums, and to 100% in two aimag centers Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved. Completed and commissioned: Dalanzadgad in Oct-2013, Sainshand in Nov-2014; Zamyn-Uud in Nov-2014; Gurvantes in Nov-2014; Tsogttsetsii in June 2015 and Khanbogd in May 2016. Data Source: Annual household survey, PUSOs annual progress reports Actual value: Y

20% reduction in average time women spend on accessing drinking water by September 2015 Achievement: 20 Progress/Status: Achieved. In average, reduction in time women spend on accessing drinking water was reduced by 30% in 2015 compared to the 2011 baseline. The baseline survey conducted in 2011 for Grant 0204 showed that 18.4% of 988 households used to spend more than 30 minutes to access the water. The interim survey concluded that 1.9% of 1,000 households spent more than 30 minutes to access the water in in 2019. Data Source: Annual household survey, PUSOs annual progress reports

At least 27,000 m3/day of fully treated wastewater discharged in nine aimags centers and soums by June 2023 Achievement: 27000 Progress/Status: For Loans 3388 and Loan 3713, the output includes construction of nine modern wastewater treatment facilities to replace inadequate wastewater stabilization pond systems. This will be achieved by building new, effective, and energy-efficient treatment processes with integrated fixed-film activated sludge (IFAS) technology. This system, designed by Mongolian engineers, is suitable for cold climate and will produce an effluent that meets national and international standards. The capacity of each plant will be 3,000 m3/d. As of 30 Dec 2023, all nine WWTPs are constructed and put into operation. Testing and calibration of two plants is ongoing. In addition, two WWTPs with smaller capacity were commissioned in Erdenedalai soum (50m3/d) and Khujrt soum (320m3/d capacity). Data Source: Project and PUSOs annual progress reports

Ger area population in five aimag centers with access to pit latrine emptying service increased Achievement: 8 Progress/Status: As of 31 December 2023, out of 27,800 households in ger areas of five aimag centers, 2,185 households have emptiable pit latrines. Data Source: Project and PUSOs annual progress reports

Ger area population with access to water kiosks within 300 meters of dwelling increased Achievement: 95 Progress/Status: Achieved. Ger area population access to water from water kiosks within 300 meters of dwelling increased from 63.4% (2011) to 90% at the end of 2015 (by interim impact survey in 2015); and 57.9% out of 991 households access to water from 300m (by baseline survey in 2011); and 69.9% or 368 households out of 1001 households access to water from 300m (by interim impact survey in 2015); and 82.9% or 459 households out of 1000 households access to water from 300m (by the end-line impact survey in 2019) respectively under G0204. Data Source: Annual statistics yearbooks of aimag governments

At least 7 of 9 PUSOs with annual revenues greater than expenses Achievement: 4 Progress/Status: Being assessed. According to Water Service Regulatory Committee, out of 9 PUSOs 4 meet the project target to have revenues greater than expenses (Bulgan, Khuvsgul, Khentii and Uvurkhangai), as of December 2022. Data Source: Annual audited financial account statements of PUSOs

Revenues of service operators increased Achievement: 100 Progress/Status: Achieved. Financial and economic reassessment of the project was conducted in August-October 2019. Institutional Development and Capacity Building consultants under Loan 3713 advised to PUSOs on the approaches to increase the revenues. Data Source: Annual audited financial account statements of PUSOs

At least 90% of new infrastructure projects commenced between 2016 and 2022 followed approved urban master plans in soums and aimag centers Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Being complied with. All 10 WWTPs and other urban infrastructure have been constructed in accordance with the respective urban master plans for aimag and soum centers. Data Source: Project annual progress reports Base year: 2018

Water, sewerage, SWM, and heating coverage in planned (non-ger) areas increased from 0% to 95% in soums, and from 95% to 100% in aimag centers Achievement: 95 Progress/Status: Achieved under Grant 0204. Data Source: Annual National Statistics Office Yearbook, national government; annual statistics yearbooks of aimag governments Baseline value: N/A
